question: Where is the nearest café along the direction of travel from City Suites Hotel, Chicago, IL to Heritage Museum and Cultural Center, Saint Joseph, MI?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.65288 41.939769)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-86.482343 42.10621)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.65288 41.939769)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.65288 41.939769)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
